tools.name: flexhr_list_departments
tools.description: List the company's departments (조직): code, parent code, name, visibility and validity dates. flex API: GET /v2/departments/all.

tools.name: flexhr_list_department_heads
tools.description: List the current heads (조직장) of the given department codes. flex API: GET /v2/departments/heads.

tools.name: flexhr_list_job_items
tools.description: List job codes: job roles (직무), positions (직위), titles (직책), ranks (직급) and job groups (직군). flex API: GET /v2/job-items/all.

tools.name: flexhr_list_cost_centers
tools.description: List the active cost centers (코스트센터). flex API: GET /v2/cost-centers/all.

tools.name: flexhr_list_custom_properties
tools.description: List the company's custom property definitions (커스텀 정보), grouped by category. Definitions only, no employee values. flex API: GET /v2/custom-properties/all.

tools.name: flexhr_list_employee_numbers
tools.description: List one page of employee numbers (사번) with a nextPageKey for the next page. flex API: GET /v2/users/employee-numbers.

tools.name: flexhr_get_employees
tools.description: Get employees by employee number: name, email, join and leave dates, primary department, job role, rank, title and level. Personal fields are never returned. flex API: GET /v2/user-masters.

tools.name: flexhr_get_employee_departments
tools.description: Get the department and job title of employees on a reference date (default: today). flex API: GET /v2/users/departments.

tools.name: flexhr_list_employee_changes
tools.description: List employees whose HR data changed on a date (joins, leaves, transfers and similar), one page at a time. A same-day query can show changes not yet final. flex API: GET /v2/users/changes/dates/{date}.

tools.name: flexhr_get_work_schedules
tools.description: Get the planned work blocks and time-off blocks per day for employees, up to 31 days. flex API: GET /v2/users/work-schedules/dates/{beginDate}/{endDate}.

tools.name: flexhr_get_work_clock_events
tools.description: Get clock-in and clock-out events of employees in a period, up to 31 days. Network and location data are never returned. flex API: GET /v2/users/work-clock-events/dates/{beginDate}/{endDate}.

tools.name: flexhr_get_work_schedules_with_clocks
tools.description: Get planned schedules together with the actual clock data per day, including work in progress and breaks, up to 31 days. flex API: GET /v2/users/work-schedules-with-work-clock/dates/{beginDate}/{endDate}.

tools.name: flexhr_get_time_off_uses
tools.description: Get the time off employees used in a period (form name, from and to date-times), up to 31 days. flex API: GET /v2/users/time-off-uses/dates/{beginDate}/{endDate}.

tools.name: flexhr_get_annual_time_off_buckets
tools.description: Get the annual leave grants (연차 부여) of employees. flex API: GET /v2/users/time-off-buckets/annual.

tools.name: flexhr_get_leave_of_absence
tools.description: Get the current leave-of-absence (휴직) status of employees. flex API: GET /v2/users/leave-of-absence.

tools.name: flexhr_list_holidays
tools.description: List public and company holidays between two dates, up to 366 days. flex API: GET /v2/holidays.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: flexhr_get_employees · Public sink: flexhr_get_employees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: flexhr_get_employees · Public sink: flexhr_get_employees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
